text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The "Grayish Club" Karaoke Party~! Let's 
all get super cute and hype things up—♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Today is an informal gathering, desu wa. 
Let us enjoy socializing regardless of 
seniority.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gathered in the karaoke room, the nine of 
them had a great time singing and 
chatting.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Chrono. Ya like takoyaki? Ya really 
got refined taste, huh!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... Besides takoyaki, I also like 
isobemaki, fried chicken cutlets, simmered 
offal, and the like...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Man, yer tastes are wicked old-school. 
Alright, next time I'm takin' ya on an 
Osaka food tour!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I always watch your Umatube channel, 
Golshi-san~. If you have any cute ideas 
again, let's collab♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I was actually thinking of doing 
something like this next, whatcha think?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Heavy Track Pro-Wrestling: The Muddiest 
Winner Takes 1st Place"? I-Is that really 
cute, I wonder...~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Conversations sparked up everywhere... and 
each took turns showing off their favorite 
songs.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That season~ will never return~, shining~ 
and sparkling~♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What's that, Oguri? What's with that Showa 
ballad kinda song...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Like a~ blue~ cloud~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Sky-chan. I feel like I've heard that 
song somewhere before...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, this is actually the jingle from an 
incense commercial. My grandpa loves it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then Curren is next☆ Kyupiiin♪ Perfect 
score, great escape, pyoi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't resist joining in on the 
call-and-response. Time flew by in a 
flash...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then, it's about time to wrap things 
up. I'd like everyone to sing a song 
fitting for the Grayish Club together, 
but... let's see...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
A song fitting for the Grayish Club, 
huh... Grayish...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's it! In that case, a song by 
that band would be great~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So I heard this from my friend Spe-chan, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
There's this greyish rock band that formed 
in her hometown of Hokkaido.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan's mom is a huge fan too! Their 
songs are pretty mainstream, but since 
they're from snow country...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
She says the snowy visuals in their music 
videos feel super authentic, which makes 
them really likeable.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Let's wrap things up by singing their 
biggest hit together. The song is called—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nah, the closer's gotta be an anime song, 
an anime song! Listen up, you lot, anime 
song time!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's go with Oguri's anime song!
All right, Oguri's anime song it is!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That song, huh. Yeah, sounds great. Let's 
all sing it together!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoops. Well then, let's save my 
suggestion for next time. Look forward to 
it~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, all members of the Greyish Club 
sang the anime song together.
